name: JK to Inkou Kyoushi 6 ~Love Love Couple Netori Hen~
original_name: JKと淫行教師6～ラブラブカップル寝取り編～
source:
The protagonist, a teacher named Yamada Takashi, felt bitter about the couples flirting around the school. Among the students, there was a couple rumored to be the best: a serious and refreshing boy and a pure and lovely girl. Takashi harbored immoral desires towards that girl, which grew day by day. One day, under the guise of supervision, he brought her back to the school at night. During a casual chat while inspecting her belongings, he learned that she hadn't even kissed her boyfriend yet.

Even with such a handsome boyfriend, she's still a virgin? Well then, there's only one thing to do!

"I'll steal her from her boyfriend and make her body and soul completely mine!"

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110527103701/http://221.245.251.42/soft/bg_707/indexpage.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
主角山田隆志是一名教師，對校園裡打情罵俏的情侶感到憤恨。學生中有一對被稱作絕配的情侶：認真清爽的男孩與純真可愛的女孩。隆志對那名女孩抱著不道德的慾望，而且一天比一天強烈。一天，他以監督為名，在夜裡把她帶回學校。隨意檢查她的物品並聊天時，他得知她甚至還沒和男友接過吻。

有這麼帥的男友還是處女？那就只剩一件事可做！

「我要從她男友手中奪走她，讓她的身體和靈魂徹底屬於我！」

[譯自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110527103701/http://221.245.251.42/soft/bg_707/indexpage.html]官方網站[/url]]
